Because daily life creates constant micro-decisions. An personal AI assistant reduces friction by organizing priorities, surfacing next steps, and helping you stay oriented without relying on multiple apps, reminders, or mental juggling. Why choose Gigi over other personal growth tools? Most tools focus on lists or reminders. Gigi understands context - goals, routines, preferences, constraints and adapts as life changes.
